audit.why: Level 2 W Rocket Jump spike, level 6 R evening the all-in, and post-first-item Nilah sustain window are all correctly identified in content.
E Explosive Charge stacking/detonation and W Rocket Jump reset-on-kill are the two abilities that actually decide this matchup, and content already names them correctly.
